# DevFlow Documentation

> Developer workflow setup for TypeScript, React, Node.js and monorepos

## Overview

DevFlow is a CLI tool that automates the setup of modern development workflows. It configures ESLint, Prettier, Husky, GitHub Actions, Vitest, Docker, and more with a single command.

**Website:** https://dev-flow.xyz
**GitHub:** https://github.com/disin8/devflow
**npm:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/create-devflow
**Install:** `npx create-devflow`

## Key Features

- **Zero-config defaults** - Works out of the box for TypeScript, React, Node.js, Next.js
- **50+ modules** - Comprehensive ecosystem covering all aspects of modern development
- **Monorepo native** - Built-in support for Turborepo, Nx, pnpm workspaces
- **Extensible** - Create custom modules for your organization
- **CI/CD ready** - Generates production-ready GitHub Actions workflows
- **Docker support** - Multi-stage builds, docker-compose, dev containers
- **Security first** - Dependency scanning, secret detection, supply chain security
- **Type-safe** - Full TypeScript support with strict mode
